profile.deleteKeyBody: New VMs will no longer get this key; running VMs keep it until their next boot.

org.identityHint: How this organization is named and referenced.

members.name: Name

members.leaveBody: You will lose access to this organization.
members.linkOnce: Copy this link now; it is shown only once.

teams.name: Name

roles.subject: Member or team
roles.deleteBody: {name} and its bindings will be removed.

limits.required: Enter a value or select unlimited
limits.invalid: Use a whole number, 0 or more

env.subtitle: Variables and secrets injected into your VMs.
env.name: Name
env.hostsPlaceholder: One host per line, e.g. api.github.com
env.hostsHint: Bind to hosts (VMs get a placeholder; the value is only sent to these hosts over HTTPS)
env.hostInvalid: Invalid host: "{host}" (up to 10 exact DNS names, no wildcard, IP or port)
env.restartNote: Programs already running in VMs trust the new host only after a restart.
env.unbindBody: VMs will receive the real value at their next boot.
env.emptyText: Add variables and secrets that are injected into your VMs.

integrations.subtitle: Connect GitHub, Claude, Linear and gcloud so your VMs can use them.
integrations.noScope: This kind is already connected in every scope you can manage.
integrations.signInHint: Sign in in the new tab, then paste the code shown there.
integrations.disconnectBody: Disconnect {kind}? VMs lose access to it.
integrations.modeProxy: Through the proxy (recommended): VMs get a placeholder
integrations.modeVm: Inside the VM: programs in the VM can read the token
integrations.teamVmWarning: Every member who can connect to a team VM can read it.
integrations.revokeBody: This token was readable inside a VM. Rotate or revoke it at the provider.
integrations.autoSwitchOff: No switch on a limit; switch yourself.
integrations.removeAccountBody: Remove {account}? The other accounts keep working.
integrations.reorder: Move {account} (drag, or use the up and down arrow keys)
integrations.switchedNote: Switched automatically at {time}: {from} reached its limit.
integrations.modeMultiHint: Remove accounts until only one is left to change the mode.
integrations.emptyText: Connect an integration so your VMs can use it. By default, VMs only get a placeholder and the proxy adds the token.
integrations.about_github: git and gh work in your VMs.
integrations.about_claude: Claude Code is signed in in your VMs.
integrations.about_linear: The Linear API and MCP work in your VMs.
integrations.about_gcloud: gcloud, Terraform and Google SDKs use your login in your VMs.
integrations.gcloudHint: Sign in on your computer, then hand the login to the hub. Repeat the second command after each new login.
integrations.quotaHint: Used by Google SDKs such as Python. gcloud sends its own project; Terraform needs user_project_override.

nodes.subtitle: Machines that run your VMs.
nodes.name: Name
nodes.installHint: Run this command as root on the machine that should become a node.
nodes.tokenNote: The token is single use and valid for 24 hours.
nodes.regenerateBody: The node disconnects until it is re-installed with the new command.
nodes.deleteBody: Delete {name}? This cannot be undone. Nodes that still host VMs cannot be deleted.
nodes.outdatedHint: The hub runs {hub}; re-run the install command to update this node.
nodes.quarantinedHelp: This node held a network port of another node. The gateway cut its underlay traffic. Regenerate its credential and re-install it to release it.

update.manual: Update by hand once: re-run the install command
update.title: Update nodes
update.pause: VMs pause briefly, memory is kept
update.restart: Hypervisor update: VMs restart, memory is lost

vms.subtitle: Virtual machines running on your nodes.
vms.name: Name
vms.hintUser: The VM gets your SSH keys and variables.
vms.hintTeam: The VM gets the team members' SSH keys and the team variables.
vms.invalidName: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; must start and end with a letter or digit; max 63 characters.
vms.autoSuspendHint: Idle means no TCP or UDP traffic other than DNS, DHCP and NTP (5 to 1440 minutes). The VM wakes on the first incoming traffic.
vms.deleteBody: Delete {name}? Its disk is removed and this cannot be undone.
vms.egressRestart: Restart long-running programs to trust new hosts.
vms.memoryHint: Desktop and browser want 4 GB RAM or more
vms.deleteAfterHint: Deletes the VM automatically: 30m, 1h, 2d or a time like 2026-11-21T08:00:00+01:00, at least 5 minutes ahead. Attached disks are kept.

devices.subtitle: WireGuard devices that connect you to your VMs.
devices.name: Name
devices.deleteBody: Delete device {name}? It will lose access immediately.
devices.configHint: Import this configuration into your WireGuard client, or scan the QR code with the mobile app.
devices.configWarning: This configuration contains the private key and cannot be shown again.
devices.qrFailed: The QR code could not be generated; use the text configuration.
devices.emptyText: Add a WireGuard device to reach your VMs from your laptop or phone.

networks.subtitle: Private networks that connect your VMs.
networks.name: Name
networks.invalidName: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; must start with a letter; max 31 characters.
networks.restartBody: {name} is running and restarts to apply the network change.
networks.restartBodySaved: {name} is paused or hibernated. Applying the network change discards the saved memory state and boots it fresh.
networks.emptyText: Create a private network so your VMs can reach each other.

vmDisks.noneAvailable: No more disks available. Only ready, unattached disks with the same owner as the VM can be attached.
vmDisks.invalidPath: Use an absolute path without trailing slash or special characters.
vmDisks.nestedPath: Mount paths must not be inside each other.
vmDisks.restartBody: {name} is running and restarts to apply the disk change.
vmDisks.restartBodySaved: {name} is paused or hibernated. Applying the disk change discards the saved memory state and boots it fresh.

disks.subtitle: Persistent disks that you can attach to VMs.
disks.name: Name
disks.invalidName: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
disks.invalidSize: Size must be between 1 and 4096 GB.
disks.storageOffline: Storage server offline. Disk changes are applied once it is back.
disks.copyHint: The copy is a full duplicate. Copying a disk that is in use may produce an inconsistent copy.
disks.copyUnsettled: This disk is in use or not settled. The copy may not be consistent; detach the disk or stop its VM first for a consistent copy.
disks.copyWarning: The copy was created, but the source disk is in use or not settled, so the copy may not be consistent.
disks.growHint: Disks can only grow. Enter a size larger than {size} GB.
disks.growRestart: Restart the attached VM if it is running, paused or hibernated to apply the new size (discards the saved memory state)
disks.releaseBody: Force release {name} from its VM? Writes the VM has not flushed may be lost.
disks.deleteBody: Delete {name}? Its data is permanently lost.
disks.emptyText: Create a persistent disk and attach it to a VM. Its data outlives the VM.

usage.none: No data yet. Metrics appear while the VM is running.
usage.noRam: RAM statistics are available after the next cold boot.
usage.diskHint: DSK is the host disk footprint of the VM: allocated blocks of its root disk image, including the guest image it was created from. It runs higher than df inside the VM.

snapshots.name: Name
snapshots.invalidName: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; must start with a letter; max 31 characters.
snapshots.restoreBody: {name} is running and restarts to restore the snapshot.
snapshots.restoreBodySaved: {name} is paused or hibernated. Restoring the snapshot discards the saved memory state and boots it fresh.
snapshots.restoreBodyStopped: Restore the disks of {name} to this snapshot. Changes made since are lost.

step.nodeAsk: Ask an admin to add a node
step.sshHint: Start a VM and connect a device first

dashboard.subtitle: Your organization at a glance.
dashboard.noOwnVms: You don't own any VMs yet.

open.title: Open {name}
open.subtitle: Pick how you want to get into this VM.
open.cliHint: Opens a shell or the desktop from your terminal
open.desktopHint: The desktop needs xpra on your computer.
open.scanHint: Opens {name} in an SSH app on your phone. The phone needs its own WireGuard device under {devices}; nothing secret is in the code.

images.subtitle: Images new VMs start from: build them from a recipe or push them.
images.name: Name
images.visibilityHint: Widening visibility deletes the existing versions; the next build or push creates shared ones. Narrowing keeps them.
images.emptyText: Create an image, write a Dockerfile and build it, or push an image built elsewhere.
images.autoHint: Rebuild the current recipe on a schedule or when a base image (FROM) gets a new version. Builds run as you; latest only moves when a build succeeds.
images.autoOnBaseChange: Rebuild when a base image changes
images.autoApproveHint: Revision {n} was saved by someone other than the person automatic builds run as. Unless its author may build the image and use its references, automatic builds skip it until someone reviews and approves it; approving makes you the person they run as.
images.logLive: Live, follows the end of the log
images.noRecipeYet: No recipe yet: add a Dockerfile at the root.
images.noRecipeText: This image has no recipe yet.
images.binary: Binary or large file, not editable here.
images.refsHint: What the build may use. Private images may use private, team and org entries, team images their team's and the org's, org images only the org's.
images.noVersions: No versions yet: build the recipe or push an image.
images.deleteVersionBody: Delete version {digest}? VMs already created from it keep running.
images.pushHint: Push an image built elsewhere; it becomes a version and moves latest.
images.deleteBody: Delete {name} with all versions, builds and logs? VMs already created from it keep running.
images.widenBody: More people would see this image. Its existing versions are deleted; the next build or push creates new ones.
images.defaultHint: The image new VMs start from when none is chosen.
images.orgDefaultHint: New VMs start from this image unless their team or owner sets their own default.
images.teamDefaultHint: New VMs of this team start from this image; without one, the org default applies.
images.userDefaultHint: Your personal VMs in {org} start from this image; without one, the org default applies.
images.defaultRemoved: the version or tag no longer exists, so the next level applies
images.buildersHint: Throwaway VMs that run image builds. They are deleted after every build.
images.logTruncated: — truncated, download for the full log —
images.logStreamFailed: The live log could not be loaded. Reload the page or download the log.

registryGC.title: Registry cleanup
registryGC.explain: Deleted versions and images take up space until the registry is cleaned up. New builds wait until running ones finish; then pushes are blocked for a few minutes. Pulls and VMs keep running.
registryGC.unmanaged: This hub does not clean up the registry itself (OBSERVATORY_REGISTRY_CONFIG is not set).

states.closed: Pushes blocked, waiting out issued tokens
